title: [Macmillan IELTS] - Dispelling irrational beliefs about exams

parts.passageHtml:
{[Here are some common beliefs that are held about exams and their outcome, all of which have some elements of false assumption or irrationality about them.][288195]}

{[My future will be ruined if I fail/don't get the grades I want.][288222]}

{[Success in examinations does open doors to particular jobs and careers.][288238]} {[Lack of success will mean certain jobs and careers are not immediately open to you.][288250]} {[Some may be closed altogether.][288270]}

{[However, happiness, wealth, peace of mind, a rich experience of life, meaningful status in the eyes of others, a worthwhile career, a useful job and a sense of purpose and self-belief as a human being do not depend upon examination results.][288283]}

{[I am not lucky with exams.][288359]}

{[Some people do appear luckier than others.][288376]} {[There is certainly an aspect of chance involved in which questions appear on the examination paper, compared to those you have chosen to revise.][288393]}

{[However, examination technique can be learned very effectively by anybody, and the element of luck reduced to a minimum.][288442]} {[Practising what you have to do in the examination room is the key.][288481]}

{[Exams get more difficult as you work your way up.][288512]}

{[Difficulty is a relative word.][288536]} {[What is difficult at one age is not at another age; what is difficult when you are inexperienced in an activity is not when you are experienced; what is difficult to one person is not for another; what is difficult on one day is not on another.][288546]}

{[Certainly, examinations demand more specialist knowledge, understanding and expertise, as you move through their different levels.][288592]} {[This does not mean they become more difficult.][288625]}

{[I haven't covered the syllabus, so I won't pass.][288645]}

{[It isn't irrational to fear that you haven't revised or understood enough of the subject you have studied to pass a course.][288669]} {[It may be true that if you have studied and revised little of the course you have left yourself at risk of failing it.][288716]}

{[However, it is irrational to believe that if you haven't covered the syllabus you are inevitably going to fail the course.][288767]} {[Examiners do not expect you to have paid full and equal attention to all parts of the syllabus.][288810]} {[They accept that there are areas where you are underprepared, unclear or uninformed.][288849]} {[They want to see you demonstrate what you understand and what you have prepared.][288875]}

{[Even when you are struggling to find enough questions to answer, you will find that many have some kind of link with your course content.][288907]} {[You will normally find some links which you can build up into an answer.][288959]}

{[The exams will expose me as a phoney, or stupid.][288989]}

{[You may experience the common fear in many students that the exams will expose them as inadequate, lacking in basic understanding.][288993]} {[There is a further underlying fear - that the exams will expose your lack of ability to be tackling that level of study.][289037]} {[You can see examiners as poised with red pens to expose your ignorance and misunderstanding.][289084]} {[You may feel that family and friends see you as stupid, or that tutors will reject you, as they feel let down or fooled.][289115]}

{[The focus on ability is largely irrelevant.][289162]} {[The vast majority of people who set off on a course of study are quite capable of successfully completing it.][289178]} {[It is practical life circumstances and negative attitudes, which, coupled with poor study techniques, may cause problems - not lack of ability.][289218]}

questionSets.instructionHtml:
Questions 1 - 8:

Are the following statements YES, NO or NOT GIVEN according to the information in the passage?

YES  the statement agrees with the writer.

NO the statement contradicts the writer

NOT GIVEN  the information is not found in the passage.

questions.text: If you fail an exam, it may be impossible to get the job that you want.
questions.explanationHtml: Đoạn 2, sau “My future will be ruined if I fail/don't get the grades I want.” thể hiện ý này Y

questions.text: Many people who have not passed exams have had satisfying careers.
questions.explanationHtml: Dễ bị nhầm khi đọc đoạn 3 (có nhiều khía cạnh không phụ thuộc vào điểm số (happiness, wealth, career,…), và có nhiều người nhận ra điều đó), nhưng từ đoạn này KHÔNG khẳng định được có nhiều người không pass exams nhưng vẫn có sự nghiệp viên mãn. NG

questions.text: Practice is not as important as luck.
questions.explanationHtml:
Đoạn 5:

However, examination technique can be learned very effectively by anybody, and the element of luck reduced to a minimum. Practising what you have to do in the examination room is the key

N

Câu này nói practice không qian trọng bằng luck à sai

questions.text: A large percentage of people who fail an exam, fail again when they re-take it.
questions.explanationHtml: Đoạn 6 có nhắc tới việc thi lại (future attempts ở đây nghĩa là “re-take” exams), nhưng không nhắc tới “larger percentage”. NG

questions.text: It is unhelpful to compare yourself with others.
questions.explanationHtml: Đoạn 6: The other is that in comparing yourself with others, you find your performance inadequate… Other people are largely irrelevant. They do not depend for their success upon your lack of success … à ý là đi so sánh mình với người khác không có ích lợi gì cả Y

questions.text: Exams become more difficult at higher levels because of the greater technical skill or knowledge required.
questions.explanationHtml: Đoạn 8 "This does NOT mean they become more difficult"

questions.text: Examiners expect you to have thoroughly studied the syllabus.
questions.explanationHtml:
Đoạn 10 (Few courses, teachers or students 'cover the syllabus' in the sense of paying full and equal attention to all parts of it. Examiners do not expect you to have done so.)

N

few courses: lưu ý chữ “few” mang nghĩa phủ định = hầu như không có course nào

questions.text: Time management is an important factor in exam success.
questions.explanationHtml: Không có thông tin về time management NG

  • In fact, 11 is not usually the problem. Most people who start a course are able to complete it successfully. More often, problems are caused by the student's negative attitude, 12 learning strategies or simply the circumstances of their life at the time.
